recognition._note: crop = text region alone (pure recognition); box = locate a 0-1000 box on the full image and read it (localisation+reading). Probes were run on ORIGINAL images only. Entity recognition is measured only as reading the entity's label; visual recognition of the entity's shape/stroke is NOT measured (unavailable).

decomposition_notes.C: a2e examples (orig+cf) whose annotation text and gold-target label were read correctly in the crop probe.
decomposition_notes.E: recognition measured on the ORIGINAL image only. The text and label pixels of the cf image are identical (pixel check in build), so this is a proxy for recognition in both images, not a direct measurement.
decomposition_notes.connector_interpretation: UNAVAILABLE as a measured quantity: no probe asks the model to trace or describe the connector. The connector-related categories in error_taxonomy_final.md are post-hoc labels of the WRONG ANSWER (e.g. it is the end of another connector), not observations of what the model perceived.
